newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australis Media half yr loss A$104 mln.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australis Media half yr loss A$104 mln.

text.p: Pay television operator Australis Media Ltd said its net loss in the six months to December 31 was A$103.6 million before abnormal items which involved the termination of a debt agreement with U.S.-based Lenfest.
Australis did not provide comparative net figures for the year ago period. But records show that its net loss in the first half of 1995/96 was A$97.50 million.

The company said on Wednesday that its 1996/97 first half operating loss based on earnings before interest, tax, depreciation and abnormal items (EBITDA), was A$39.5 million. This was A$35.8 million lower than the loss in the 1995/96 second half and A$44.5 million lower than a year ago.
It said the operating loss in the second quarter of the current financial year was A$21.1 million compared with a A$18.5 million first quarter loss.
Australis said sales in the latest six months were A$55.8 million, an increase of A$42.6 million on the year-ago result.

The company said the major abnormal item was the termination of a long term liability under the "Lenfest Technical Services Agreement for the issue of 70,238,547 securities in the company for A$38.3 million"
